I build computational pipelines and ML models for biological imaging — multimodal registration (in vivo two-photon ↔ ex vivo light-sheet ↔ spatial transcriptomics), 3D ROI quality classification, and increasingly, agentic-AI-assisted tooling for scientific data workflows. Currently a Scientist II at the Allen Institute for Neural Dynamics. **[See recent projects →](projects.qmd)**
